expectedResults: The log shows that the destination volume aliases "Report.txt" and "report.txt": true.
All seven TestDownloadDestinationCaseCollision subtests run without skips. Both destination states pass for every subtest.

Download returns failed_precondition with both archive names for both orders of a regular file and a hard link, and for two hard links. The existing destination keeps only keep.txt with the original contents. The absent destination stays absent. Local staging and the guest archive are removed.

The native link scenarios and the injected fallback scenarios both pass. Exact-name replacements and the hard-link extraction limits pass. TestDownloadHardLinkFallback runs on macOS and may skip its POSIX fixture on Windows.
